prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "Apply video production expertise to this task". The source material has target-format constraints, noisy or incomplete input, accessibility/legibility requirements, and an export path that can silently degrade quality. The acceptance boundary is video-production: Define audience, outcome, duration, platform/aspect, narrative beats, shot grammar, pacing, visual continuity, motion language, voice/music/SFX, captions, and brand constraints. The adjacent audio-production discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. A happy path alone is insufficient.

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual video-production boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=human-experience; near-neighbor=audio-production), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Define audience, outcome, duration, platform/aspect, narrative beats, shot grammar, pacing, visual continuity, motion language, voice/music/SFX, captions, and brand constraints.
The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible.

Review full renders plus key frames for pacing, cuts, legibility, caption timing, audio levels, clipping, motion continuity, encoding, and target-platform dimensions; test beginning/end and seek points explicitly.

The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: Do not overuse motion presets, let captions obscure primary content, rely on draft-preview timing as final render proof, or use copyrighted media without appropriate rights.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (video-production decision and boundary evidence; Representative verification results or explicit unavailable checks; Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale; Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
